channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bobby Portis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bobby Portis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pat Riley on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Your Miami HEAT announced today that they have acquired NBA Champion, Two-Time NBA MVP and 10-time NBA All-Star Giannis Antetokounmpo and NBA Champion Bobby Portis Jr. from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Tyler Herro, Kasparas Jakučionis, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel’el Ware, three first round picks…

“The announcement of today’s trade for Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis Jr. is one of the great trades in HEAT history,”

Pat Riley on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis, Jul 6, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Bucks head coach Doc Rivers said.

“When you think about having the scoring off the floor that we had – no Dame, no Khris Middleton, no Bobby Portis, no Ryan (Rollins) so we’re down to one living point guard on our team – and for him to do that and for us to score 127 points, though he got half of them almost, every basket was needed.”

Doc Rivers on Khris Middleton, Bobby Portis, Nov 14, 2024. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Patrick Beverley on Bobby Portis
item.description:
“My boy Bobby [Portis] don’t play… ‘Hey Bobby, he hit me.’ He’s like, ‘Who?’… ‘Him!’… ‘Alright, I got you, Pat.’”

Patrick Beverley on Bobby Portis, Mar 12, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: DeMar DeRozan on Bobby Portis
item.description:
KC Johnson:DeRozan on Portis Jr.:

“He stared at me. That’s all it takes for me. I don’t care who it is. It could be the janitor in the hallway. Look at me a certain type of way. Like, just play basketball. Get the rebound and play. I’ve just never been a player with the extra theatrics.”

DeMar DeRozan on Bobby Portis, Mar 3, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Bobby Portis
item.description:
“It's rare. I've been in the league 16 years, and I've never seen that until the other day on camera. You hear about it with MJ and you hear about it with Bobby Portis, but there's nothing that's happening every year. It's very rare that something like that happens.”

Kevin Durant on Bobby Portis, Oct 13, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Grayson Allen on Brook Lopez, Serge Ibaka, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis
item.description:
“When a guy’s driving, you don’t want to over-help or shift all the way. You kind of trust that either the guy guarding the ball is going to guard his guy straight upor it’s going to be Brook (Lopez), Giannis (Antetokounmpo), Bobby (Portis), Serge (Ibaka), one of the bigger guys coming over. “And then the guards are more staying home and either trying to completely limit the pass or if they do get the pass off, just be there, so they can’t get the shot off. It’s slightly different with our habits off the ball, so it’s not a huge change.”

Grayson Allen on Brook Lopez, Serge Ibaka, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Bobby Portis, Oct 4, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Wendell Carter on Bobby Portis
item.description:
Wendell Carter on if team talked about Portis revenge game:

“No words need to be said. We're not letting that happen. Bobby is going to want to put on a show. I'm not going to have it. I hope he's watching this. I ain't having it.”

Wendell Carter on Bobby Portis, Nov 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Brooks on Portis:

“It's a great pickup. It's a great pickup. He loves to play. And the intel that I've got — talked to over coaches — is he's a gym rat. And Parker, he's an athletic guy. He's hard to guard. He's strong. He's a strong athlete.”

Scott Brooks on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis, Feb 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Jim Boylen on Bobby Portis
item.description:
KC Johnson:Jim Boylen:

“Bobby Portis has the ability to raise the level of your practice, which we need.”

Jim Boylen on Bobby Portis, Dec 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Bobby Portis
item.description:
KC Johnson:Hoiberg on Portis injury:

“Bobby has been so durable early in his career. Just to see his reaction, you knew it was something seriouswhen he went flying in the crowd. We’re thankful it wasn’t a more severe injury.”

Fred Hoiberg on Bobby Portis, Oct 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis
item.description:
Fred Hoiberg on starting Jabari Parker at PF over Bobby Portis:

“We need to play Jabari at that position. And we love Bobby’s energy and the role that he’s played pretty much since he’s been here is that sixth man. So that was really the decision.”

Fred Hoiberg on Jabari Parker, Bobby Portis, Sep 29, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: John Paxson on Bobby Portis
item.description:
Bulls vice president of basketball operations John Paxson said.

“We’ve got these three young talents and you can throw Bobby Portis in, he fits the direction that we’re headed in. We feel we’re headed in the right direction. But we don’t want to oversell anything. We know to win at the highest level in this league you need the great players, and, hopefully, we’ve got one or two of them, somewhere on our roster, that we can grow with and hopefully make the decisions going forward to add to that.”

John Paxson on Bobby Portis, Jan 26, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Nikola Mirotic on Bobby Portis
item.description:
Nikola Mirotic on the Bobby Portis incident:

“Not even in your worst nightmares you expect that to happen, much less with a teammate in practice. It's not the time to go into detail and talk about it. It was a tough time because I had given up on the National Team, I had put in the work in the summer, because I was going to be in the starting lineup and felt this was going to be my year. I knew because I felt ready... Not being able to start the season and lose your spot over something like that was very hard. It took time for me to understand and be positive, but I have proved nothing can break me.”

Nikola Mirotic on Bobby Portis, Dec 31, 2017. Source: Marca.com.

item.title: Nikola Mirotic on Bobby Portis
item.description:
Mirotic on Portis:

“I've been playing this game 9 years professionally. I was always a good teammate, always professional with everybody. I'm going to continue to do that. If I'm here, it's because I want to support the team. He's a part of the team. I'm going to support him too”

Nikola Mirotic on Bobby Portis, Nov 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Fred Hoiberg on Bobby Portis
item.description:
“[Portis has] been practicing, and that will all be discussed in the next couple days, exactly what we're going to do in the Toronto game,”

Fred Hoiberg on Bobby Portis, Nov 5, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Bobby Portis
item.description:
As Butler recounted the highlights from his triple-double (19 points, 10 rebounds and 10 assists), he also delivered a message to Portis, who was standing in front of a nearby locker.

“I know if Bobby smacks my hand as hard as he did again,”

Jimmy Butler on Bobby Portis, Apr 7, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Doug McDermott, Bobby Portis
item.description:
“I sit there and listen to (Gasol) talk. He talks to Doug (McDermott), he talks to Bobby (Portis),”

Taj Gibson on Pau Gasol, Doug McDermott, Bobby Portis, Feb 20, 2016. Source: CSN Chicago.
